answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding collateral across identities: when k coordinated identities equivocate on shared consensus evidence, pairwise-correlated faults trigger penalties scaling as O(k^2), not k independent flat fines. Detection applies an exponential multiplier to swarm capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation makes recovered value lower than bonded value. quartz, onyx, and timber escrow tiers may diversify custody, but cannot dilute shared-evidence liability.
